b1-17-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Role or Comparison
b1-17-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg why she is still at the office late in the evening. You (Meg) say that as a colleague you want to help, and that today you are working like a machine.
b1-17-01.prompt: Tell Petra in what role you want to help and how you work today.
cues: Say in what role you want to help
Say how you work today, as a comparison
b1-17-01.target: Kollégaként segíteni akarok. Ma úgy dolgozom, mint egy gép.
b1-17-01.english: As a colleague I want to help. Today I'm working like a machine.
b1-17-01.canDo: I can tell -ként (a role) from mint (a comparison).

b1-17-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Per Family
b1-17-02.scenario: Anna asks Meg what she read in the news about support for families. You (Meg) say that the support is calculated per family, and that in the cities there is a lot of work, in contrast to the countryside.
b1-17-02.prompt: Tell Anna how the support is calculated and what the work is like in the cities and in the countryside.
cues: Say how the support is calculated
Contrast the cities with the countryside
b1-17-02.target: A támogatást családonként számolják ki. A városokban sok a munka, ezzel szemben vidéken kevés.
b1-17-02.english: The support is calculated per family. In the cities there is a lot of work, in contrast to the countryside there is little.
b1-17-02.canDo: I can say how much or how often per person, family or group with -nként.

b1-17-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Fair for Children
b1-17-03.scenario: Petra says that some people find the school system unfair. You (Meg) say that it is fair for every child to get a good education, and that people in need receive welfare aid.
b1-17-03.prompt: Tell Petra what is fair and who receives welfare aid.
cues: Say what is fair for every child
b1-17-03.target: Igazságos, hogy minden gyerek jó oktatást kapjon. A rászorulók segélyben részesülnek.
b1-17-03.english: It is fair that every child gets a good education. People in need receive welfare aid.
b1-17-03.canDo: I can say that something is fair or unfair with igazságos and méltányos and hogy + -jon/-jen.

b1-17-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Good Organisations
b1-17-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg which civil organisations she thinks do a good job. You (Meg) say that those organisations are good that help people in need, and that the helping volunteers do a lot for the community.
b1-17-04.prompt: Tell Károly which organisations you mean and what the volunteers do.
cues: Say what the helping volunteers do
b1-17-04.target: Azok a civil szervezetek jók, amelyek segítenek a rászorulóknak. A segítő önkéntesek sokat tesznek a közösségért.
b1-17-04.english: Those civil organisations are good that help people in need. The helping volunteers do a lot for the community.
b1-17-04.canDo: I can say which organizations or programs do something, with azok a … amelyek and olyan … amelyek.

b1-17-05.title: Communicative Challenge: How I See the Future
b1-17-05.scenario: Anna asks Meg how she sees the future of society. You (Meg) say that as you see it, social dialogue is important, and that you trust that future generations will get more equal chances.
b1-17-05.prompt: Tell Anna what you think is important and what you trust.
cues: Say what you think is important
Say what you trust about future generations
b1-17-05.target: Úgy látom, hogy a társadalmi párbeszéd fontos. Bízom benne, hogy a jövő generációi egyenlőbb esélyeket kapnak.
b1-17-05.english: As I see it, social dialogue is important. I trust that future generations will get more equal chances.
b1-17-05.canDo: I can give my view with úgy látom, hogy and véleményem szerint.

b1-17-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Helping the Village
b1-17-consolidation.scenario: Károly tells Meg about a village where many families are in need. You (Meg) say that the volunteers help the families in need, and that voluntary work is important for the community.
b1-17-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly what the volunteers do and why voluntary work matters.
cues: Say who helps the families in need
b1-17-consolidation.target: Az önkéntesek segítenek a rászoruló családoknak. Az önkéntes munka fontos a közösségnek.
b1-17-consolidation.english: The volunteers help families in need. Voluntary work is important for the community.
b1-17-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about fairness, help and living together in society.
